summary: Release 42613625809 (and every Release since dev's Grafana instance came back from archive) failed creating grafana_cloud_stack_service_account.observability with 400 Bad Request. While archived, the retirement forgot the account and views from state but Grafana kept them, and Grafana refuses a second account of the same name. A foundation apply that would recreate the account now adopts what was kept: an account pass imports it by name and creates a uniquely named token, then a views pass imports the kept folder, dashboards, rule groups and SLOs.
